en.name: China-LATAM FinTech Cup
en.description: A challenge for financial infrastructure founders building inclusion, payments, treasury, and embedded-finance products for emerging markets.
en.detailSubtitle: Designed for teams building compliant, practical financial rails between high-growth markets in Latin America and China.
en.metaTitle: China-LATAM FinTech Cup | LATAM China Tech
en.metaDescription: Review the China-LATAM FinTech Cup for startups building payments, financial inclusion, and treasury products.
en.overviewHtml: The China-LATAM FinTech Cup spotlights founders translating financial infrastructure lessons between Brazil, Mexico, China, and the wider LATAM corridor.
en.eligibilityHtml:
• Founders building B2B or B2B2C financial products.
  • Teams with a clear compliance or partnership path.
  • Products focused on inclusion, payments, FX, treasury, or credit infrastructure.
en.supportHtml:
• Exposure to fintech operators, investors, and ecosystem partners.
  • Structured feedback on cross-border market-entry positioning.
  • Support packaging the final submission and follow-up materials.
en.processHtml:
1. Choose this competition on the shared application form.
  2. Submit your project, deck, and supporting materials.
  3. Receive feedback and next-step coordination from the team.

br.name: China-LATAM FinTech Cup
br.description: Um desafio para founders de infraestrutura financeira focados em inclusao, pagamentos, tesouraria e embedded finance em mercados emergentes.
br.detailSubtitle: Voltado para equipes que constroem rails financeiros praticos e aderentes para operar entre America Latina e China.
br.metaTitle: China-LATAM FinTech Cup | LATAM China Tech
br.metaDescription: Veja o China-LATAM FinTech Cup para startups que constroem pagamentos, inclusao financeira e infraestrutura de tesouraria.
br.overviewHtml: O China-LATAM FinTech Cup destaca founders que traduzem licoes de infraestrutura financeira entre Brasil, Mexico, China e o corredor LATAM mais amplo.
br.eligibilityHtml:
• Founders com produtos financeiros B2B ou B2B2C.
  • Times com caminho claro de compliance ou parceria.
  • Solucoes para inclusao, pagamentos, FX, tesouraria ou credito.
br.supportHtml:
• Exposicao para operadores de fintech, investidores e parceiros de ecossistema.
  • Feedback estruturado sobre posicionamento cross-border.
  • Apoio para empacotar submissao final e materiais complementares.
br.processHtml:
1. Escolha esta competicao no formulario padrao.
  2. Envie projeto, deck e materiais complementares.
  3. Receba feedback e coordenacao dos proximos passos.

cn.name: China-LATAM FinTech Cup
cn.description: 面向支付、普惠金融、司库和嵌入式金融产品团队的跨境挑战赛。
cn.detailSubtitle: 适合正在构建实用且合规金融基础设施的团队，目标市场覆盖拉美和中国。
cn.metaTitle: China-LATAM FinTech Cup | LATAM China Tech
cn.metaDescription: 查看 China-LATAM FinTech Cup，适合构建支付、普惠金融与司库产品的创业团队。
cn.overviewHtml: China-LATAM FinTech Cup 聚焦能够把巴西、墨西哥、中国及更广泛拉美市场的金融基础设施经验转化为新产品的团队。
cn.eligibilityHtml:
• 构建 B2B 或 B2B2C 金融产品的创业者。
  • 具有明确合规路径或合作伙伴策略的团队。
  • 聚焦普惠金融、支付、外汇、司库或信用基础设施的方案。
cn.supportHtml:
• 接触金融科技运营者、投资人和生态伙伴。
  • 获得跨境市场定位反馈。
  • 在最终提交材料前获得整理与优化支持。
cn.processHtml:
1. 在统一申请表中选择该竞赛。
  2. 提交项目介绍、演示材料和补充文件。
  3. 团队跟进反馈并安排下一步。
